tools.name: illust_create_session
tools.description: Create a new vector document session.

tools.name: illust_get_session
tools.description: Fetch session state.

tools.name: illust_duplicate_session
tools.description: Clone an existing session.

tools.name: illust_list_sessions
tools.description: List sessions known to this client.

tools.name: illust_delete_session
tools.description: Permanently delete a session.

tools.name: illust_copy_objects_to_session
tools.description: Move objects between sessions.

tools.name: illust_set_document
tools.description: Update document width/height/background.

tools.name: illust_add_object
tools.description: Add a shape/text/path. type=rect|ellipse|line|polygon|star|text|path|image.

tools.name: illust_add_svg
tools.description: Parse and import a raw SVG string into the session.

tools.name: illust_import_from_url
tools.description: Fetch external image/SVG by URL (public IP only, http(s) port 80/443, max 5MB).

tools.name: illust_get_object
tools.description: Get a single object by id.

tools.name: illust_update_object
tools.description: Update properties of an object.

tools.name: illust_delete_object
tools.description: Delete an object by id.

tools.name: illust_duplicate_object
tools.description: Clone an object with optional offset.

tools.name: illust_group
tools.description: Group multiple objects.

tools.name: illust_ungroup
tools.description: Ungroup a group object.

tools.name: illust_align
tools.description: Align/distribute objects. mode = left|hcenter|right|top|vcenter|bottom|hdistribute|vdistribute.

tools.name: illust_set_order
tools.description: Z-order. order = front|back|forward|backward.

tools.name: illust_measure_text
tools.description: Compute bounding box for a hypothetical text.

tools.name: illust_replace_text
tools.description: Bulk replace text across the session.

tools.name: illust_set_text_style
tools.description: Bulk update text style on selected ids.

tools.name: illust_outline_text
tools.description: Convert text objects to vector paths.

tools.name: illust_list_fonts
tools.description: List built-in font families.

tools.name: illust_add_font
tools.description: Load a custom font from URL.

tools.name: illust_save_project
tools.description: Snapshot current session as a project JSON.

tools.name: illust_load_project
tools.description: Restore from a project JSON.

tools.name: illust_export
tools.description: Export the session. format = svg|svg-optimized|png|jpeg|pdf|ai|json.

tools.name: illust_batch_render
tools.description: Generate variants from a template. Up to 1000 items.

tools.name: illust_suggest_palette
tools.description: 12 mood themes (warm/cool/pastel/mono/vivid/和/夏/秋/冬/春/natural/tech).

tools.name: illust_suggest_font
tools.description: 8 use-case themes (logo/heading/body/japanese-logo/japanese-body/casual/serious/tech).

tools.name: illust_extract_palette
tools.description: Extract dominant colors from existing objects.

tools.name: illust_clip_mask
tools.description: Apply a clipping mask: the mask object is used as a clip shape on the content objects. The mask object is removed afterward.

tools.name: illust_release_clip
tools.description: Remove clipping mask from objects.

tools.name: illust_opacity_mask
tools.description: Apply an opacity mask: white = visible, black = transparent. Like clip but with gradient transparency.

tools.name: illust_release_opacity_mask
tools.description: Remove opacity mask from objects.

tools.name: illust_text_on_path
tools.description: Bind a text object to follow a path. The text will be rendered along the path curve.

tools.name: illust_release_text_on_path
tools.description: Unbind text from path. Returns to normal positioned text.

tools.name: illust_save_symbol
tools.description: Save selected objects as a reusable symbol. Symbol can be instantiated multiple times.

tools.name: illust_list_symbols
tools.description: List symbols saved in this session.

tools.name: illust_create_symbol_instance
tools.description: Place a symbol instance at given coordinates.

tools.name: illust_blend
tools.description: Create N interpolated objects between two paths/shapes (Illustrator-style blend). Colors are interpolated too.

tools.name: illust_pathfinder
tools.description: Boolean operations on closed paths: union (combine) / intersect (common area) / subtract (front minus back) / exclude (XOR).

tools.name: illust_generate_image
tools.description: Generate an image via OpenAI (DALL-E) / Recraft API and insert into the session. Requires your own API key (BYOK). Server does not store the key.

tools.name: illust_critique
tools.description: AI Vision feedback loop: renders current session to PNG, asks Claude/GPT Vision to critique. Returns structured issues + suggested fixes. BYOK.

tools.name: illust_session_snapshot
tools.description: Snapshot current session as a named version. Up to 30 versions retained per session.

tools.name: illust_session_versions
tools.description: List saved versions of this session.

tools.name: illust_session_restore
tools.description: Restore a saved version. Automatically snapshots current state first (autosave: true by default).

tools.name: illust_session_comment
tools.description: Session comments (annotations with optional x,y coordinates or object_id). action = add | list | resolve | delete

tools.name: illust_macro_save
tools.description: Save a sequence of MCP method calls as a reusable macro. Only safe (non-BYOK) methods are allowed in macros (whitelist enforced).

tools.name: illust_macro_list
tools.description: List macros saved in this session.

tools.name: illust_macro_run
tools.description: Execute a saved macro, with optional {{var}} substitution in params. Returns per-step results.

tools.name: illust_logo_variations
tools.description: Generate color variations of the current logo (mono/inverse/gray/orange/blue/red/green/gold). Optionally creates a new editable session per variant.

tools.name: illust_logo_export_kit
tools.description: Export logo at multiple sizes: favicon (16/32), apple-touch (180), PWA (192/512), Twitter card (1200x630), Instagram post (1080), and master SVG. Returns ZIP base64.

tools.name: illust_live_trace
tools.description: Convert a raster image object to vector paths (potrace). Returns single combined path or removes original image and inserts vector.

tools.name: illust_export_print_pdf
tools.description: Export print-ready PDF with trim marks (トンボ), bleed (塗り足し), optional registration marks. Standard for professional print shops.

tools.name: illust_preflight_check
tools.description: Pre-flight check: detect print-readiness issues (bleed, text near edge, RGB warning, fonts not outlined). Returns score 0-10 and structured issues + warnings.

tools.name: illust_library_search
tools.description: Search the parts library (icons, decorations, frames). Returns matching parts you can insert.

tools.name: illust_library_get
tools.description: Fetch a single library part by slug (returns name, category, tags, svg_body, default_w, default_h). Session not required.

tools.name: illust_library_use
tools.description: Insert a library part into the session at given coordinates.

tools.name: illust_template_list
tools.description: List ready-made templates (business cards, flyers, banners, posters, labels, etc.) you can use as a base.

tools.name: illust_template_render
tools.description: Create a new session from a template, with variable substitution (e.g. {{name}}, {{title}}, {{phone}}).

tools.name: illust_add_mesh_gradient
tools.description: Generate a smooth 2D color gradient via bilinear interpolation. Specify 4 corner colors or a full N×M grid. detail (8-60) controls smoothness; 576-3600 polygons.

corners.description: array (4 hex colors: [tl, tr, bl, br])

colors.description: array (N×M flat hex array for full grid)

tools.name: illust_brand_save
tools.description: Save a brand kit (palette + fonts + asset URLs). Anonymous owner_fp (ip+ua hash). Pass kit_id to overwrite.

tools.name: illust_brand_list
tools.description: List your brand kits.

tools.name: illust_brand_delete
tools.description: Delete a brand kit.

tools.name: illust_share_create
tools.description: Issue a read-only share URL for the current session (30 days valid). Viewers see live updates via 3-second polling at /illustmaker/live/{token}.

tools.name: illust_share_list
tools.description: List your active share links.

tools.name: illust_share_delete
tools.description: Invalidate a share link.

tools.name: illust_share_view
tools.description: Public endpoint (no auth). Returns current SVG for the share token. Live viewer page polls this every 3 seconds.

tools.name: illust_share_comment_post
tools.description: Public endpoint: viewers post a comment on a shared session (requires mode="comment" share link). Optional x/y for spatial annotations. Rate-limited to 20/hour per viewer fingerprint.

tools.name: illust_share_comment_list
tools.description: Public endpoint: list active comments on a share token. include_resolved=true to also include resolved ones.

tools.name: illust_share_comment_resolve
tools.description: Owner only: mark a viewer comment as resolved (or unresolved).

tools.name: illust_share_comment_delete
tools.description: Owner only: soft-delete a viewer comment.

tools.name: illust_collab_join
tools.description: Join a collaborative editing session (requires mode="edit" share link). Returns actor_id, initial state, and last_seq.

actor_id.description: string (optional, to rejoin with stable id)

tools.name: illust_collab_leave
tools.description: Leave the collab session.

tools.name: illust_collab_op_submit
tools.description: Submit an operation to the collab log. op_type = add_object | update_object | delete_objects | set_document | reorder_objects | cursor | selection | lock_object | unlock_object. Returns the new seq number (or skipped for ephemeral ops like cursor/selection).

tools.name: illust_collab_poll
tools.description: Long-poll for collab ops after `since` seq (max 25s). Returns ops list, current participants (with cursor/selection), and active per-object locks.

tools.name: illust_collab_status
tools.description: Lightweight non-blocking status: participant count, op count, last seq.

tools.name: illust_health
tools.description: Health/version check.

tools.name: gallery_submit
tools.description: Publish the current session as a gallery work. Auto-generates SVG/PNG/project JSON from the session.

tools.name: gallery_list
tools.description: List gallery works. sort = new|popular.

tools.name: gallery_get
tools.description: Fetch one gallery work in detail by slug.

tools.name: gallery_remix
tools.description: Open a gallery work as a new editable session. Returns new session id you can keep modifying.

tools.name: gallery_list_comments
tools.description: List comments on a gallery work (flat with parent_id for threading).

tools.name: gallery_comment
tools.description: Post a comment or reply on a gallery work. Pass parent_id to reply.
